# Daily AI Eval — 2026-10-05 (~6:50 AM PT)

**Core question: is the code making AI usage better or worse?**
**Answer: SLIGHTLY BETTER on cost, NO DATA on reliability.** OpenRouter's new week opened Sun 5 PM PT and spend is back under every cap, Hermes' cost estimate now matches the real bill (est ~$1.46 vs billed $1.35 since yesterday, versus $1.28 est vs $4.68 billed the day before), and the overrun guard auto-restored and caught a thrash window on its own. But the app made **0 real AI calls** since Sat Oct 3 1:07 PM PT, so ok_rate can't move, and the guard still can't stop a session that's already running.

## Budget
- **OpenRouter** (live auth_key, 6:44 AM PT): UTC day (since Sun 5 PM PT) **$0.48 / $1.65**; new week **$0.48 / $11.50**; month **$19.74 / $50**; balance **$17.28** (credits 280). Billed since yesterday's report **$1.35** (usage 259.77 → 261.12). Last week closed at about **$21.4 / $11.50 (~186%)** (derived: $20.56 at yesterday's report + ~$0.87 before the UTC rollover). Fallover spend week $0.
- **Hermes overrun guard**: tripped Sat Oct 3 8:13 AM PT (week over) → **auto-restored Sun Oct 4 5:00 PM PT** when the OpenRouter week reset → tripped again **6:45 PM PT on thrash** (20 Hermes calls in 15 min) → restored 6:50 PM PT. Not tripped now.
- **Grok Bot** (estimate from Shanta's readings, no new reading today): new cycle started ~Sat Oct 3; 1% at Oct 3 8:07 AM PT, **18% at Sun Oct 4 6:48 AM PT** with 2 days to reset → burn ~17–18%/day; projected **~35% now** and **~50–55% at the ~Tue Oct 6 reset**. Soft daily max from the last reading ≈ 41%/day. On track; no early warning.
- **Super Grok**: meter fresh (6:44 AM PT) **22% used / 78% left**, reset **Thu Oct 8 10:31 AM PT**, guard daily cap 19%, used today 0. No Hermes xai-oauth calls this week, so ~78% is sitting idle while coding is paid on OpenRouter.

## Code changes since 2026-10-04 ~6:40 AM PT
- **aisystem** (worktree branch `aisystem`, HEAD 88d7b88f8): **no new commits**. Uncommitted: `ai_openrouter_prices.json` (price refresh), 3D/inventory files, `Model/AI2/ModelSiteSearch.pm` + `SearchString.pm` → **too little data** (no AI calls).
- **main** (HEAD 55c37cc28): `0b2cd7a13` Merge planning (Oct 4 4:00 PM PT) brings 3D external model search (`ModelSiteSearch.pm`, `SearchString.pm`), inventory categories, schema compare → **too little data** for AI (0 app calls). `55c37cc28` gitignore 3D uploads → **no effect**.
- **Config/ops, not code**: Hermes default was manually set to `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` during the trip (seen in the 5:00 PM backup); the guard's restore put it back to `north-mini-code:free`, overwriting that choice → **regressed** (restore clobbers manual changes). Guard thrash trip worked as designed but couldn't affect the live session (config is read at session start) → **no effect** on spend.
- Carry-over `1406d007b` (guard/UsageEstimator): restore-on-reset now verified working → **improved**.

## Scorecard trend
- **App ok_rate 7d**: raw 62.2% (28/45) → **58.3% (28/48)**. The drop is only the guard's 3 trip/restore rows logged as Hermes "errors" (0 tokens); real calls unchanged. Excluding all 10 guard rows: **28/38 = 73.7%**.
- **App 1d**: 0 real calls (3 guard rows). Chat last call Sat Oct 3 1:07 PM PT; AI Editor last call Sep 11.
- **cost_per_ok** 7d $0.0052; cost_wasted ≈ $0 (failed calls were free 429/404).
- **Zero-token "success"**: 4 rows on Oct 1 marked ok with 0 tokens (carry-over); none new.
- **404/429/402/timeouts** 7d: 429 ×5 (gemma-31b), 404 ×1 (nemotron-nano), 402 0. None in 24h.
- **Grounding**: no new app calls, grounded_rate / flagged_per_call **n/a**.
- **Hermes** since report: 3 sessions, **329 API calls, est $1.46**, all `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`; **$0.49/session**; model hops 0; 10 open sessions (1 live) unarchived. Biggest: "Add UART motor support via BESST tool" (cli) **257 calls, est $1.28, 62M cache-read tokens**, 8:55 AM–7:12 PM PT — paid coding on flash.
- **Hermes billing accuracy**: est/billed ≈ 1.08 today vs 0.27 yesterday → **improved** (flash-0731 isn't routed to Relace's full-price cache billing).
- **Hermes 7d**: 35 sessions, 2588 API calls, est $6.42 (v4-pro 763 calls, flash-0731 552, flash 295, grok-build 328, grok-4.7 261).

### Thrash (≥20 calls / 15 min, same user+provider+model)
- **App detector**: none (1d and 7d anomalies list only error_spike gemma-31b 7/7, already removed from chains).
- **Hermes (assistant turns)**: 5 windows since report — BESST session 33 (9:45 AM), 21 (10:00), 20 (10:30), 20 (6:30 PM PT, tripped the guard); "Fix unsafe SVG path" 21 (7:00 AM). One long agent loop, not model ping-pong.

### Effectiveness (≥10 calls)
- No app model reached 10 calls in 1d or 7d → too little data. north-mini-code:free 9/9 ok (keep-trend), gemma-31b 0/7 (already removed), all_exhausted 6 (Sep 30 title runs).
- Hermes per-call ok/flagged isn't recorded → n/a.

## Failover health
- 7d fallover rate **11.8%**; first-choice answered 15, answered after failover **2** (both succeeded on free models), failed attempts 6, all_exhausted 6 (Sep 30, failover=0 title runs). Last 24h: **0 turns**.
- Open circuits: `gemma-4-31b-it:free` only (already in removed[]). No free→paid failover past caps; fallover spend week $0.
- Chains: coding/chat north-mini → nemotron-3.5-lightning → Ollama; docs/title nemotron first.

## Chat UX
- No Chat traffic since Sat 1:07 PM PT, so no new sample. Chat 7d (fallover rates) 22/32 = 68.8%.

## HelpDesk
- CSC mailbox watch still paused; no HelpDesk AI calls in the ledger.

## Proposals (review first)
1. **Stop counting guard trip/restore rows as failed AI calls** (code, UsageMonitor/usage_live): they drag ok_rate down with 0-token "errors".
2. **Guard restore should not clobber a manual default change** (workstation, overrun guard): restore to the model in place right before restore when it was changed during the trip, or ask.
3. **Use the idle Super Grok** (workstation, Hermes config): ~78% left until Thu 10:31 AM PT; route hard coding (aliases `code`/`editor`/`xai`) to grok-build-0.1 / grok-4.6 until the reset instead of paid flash-0731/v4-pro. Keep north-mini as idle default.
4. **Cap runaway single sessions** (workstation, Hermes): BESST session ran 257 calls / ~$1.28 in one context; turn on `tool_loop_guardrails.hard_stop_enabled` and have the thrash trip post a notice into live sessions.
5. Carry-over: archive the 10 stale open Hermes sessions.
